findings.summary_md: NVD published the CVE record for CVE-2026-48382 on October 13, 2026, describing an Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Adobe Experience Manager that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user without requiring user interaction. The record references Adobe security bulletin APSB26-152 as its vendor advisory. This CVE entry predates the story's first-seen timestamp by roughly 19 hours.
findings.title: NVD CVE-2026-48382 detail: Adobe Experience Manager incorrect authorization RCE

findings.summary_md: NVD published the CVE record for CVE-2026-48383 on October 13, 2026, the second CVSS 10.0 incorrect authorization flaw in Adobe Experience Manager leading to arbitrary code execution, likewise referencing Adobe bulletin APSB26-152. Sibling records for CVE-2026-106629 and CVE-2026-106634 in the same AEM cluster were published minutes earlier the same evening. Together these records confirm the AEM cluster was vendor-disclosed on October 13, a day before the national advisory aggregated it.
findings.title: NVD CVE-2026-48383 detail: second Adobe Experience Manager CVSS 10.0 authorization RCE
